messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Review and Decision-Making" as it appears in the following examples.
['Furthermore, you can indicate your option towards assisting me as I believe that this transaction would be concluded within 14days,from the day you signify interest to assist me.', 'Meanwhile, on indication of your willingness to handle this transaction sincerely by protecting our interests and upon your acceptance of this proposal, I would furnish you with the full detailed information, amount involved and mutually agree on your percentage interest or share holding for helping me to secure the release of the deposit.', 'Accept Decline', 'Accept Decline', 'REPLY URGENT TO INDICATE YOUR INTEREST IN THIS TRANSACTION THROUGH MY PRIVATE EMAIL ADDRESS AT chinaeke12@juno.com', 'Please if you are willing to assist me and my only son Francis, indicate your interest in replying soonest.', 'I WILL GIVE YOU FURTHER Detail WHEN I GET YOUR RESPONSE TO THIS LETTER ASSURING US THAT YOU WILL BE ABLE TO REPRESENT US IN THE NETHERLANDS THAT WILL MAKE THIS TRANSACTION CONFIDENTIAL.', 'Can you be my partner on this?', 'Please click on the link below to begin signing.', 'If this Proposal is all right by you.', 'Can you honestly help me from your heart?', 'All I require is your consent and honest co-operation to enable us see the deal through.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
